llms_summary: ClaudeFleet is a set of always-on AI sessions: say what you need on your laptop or phone, and a session builds the dashboard, page, doc or slides and tells you when it's done — one session per task, every session seen and answered in one place. Limited access for now: scan a WeChat code to try it for 15 minutes; longer use is by application or invitation. Bring your own Claude subscription if you like.
llms_summary_apply: ClaudeFleet is a set of always-on AI sessions: say what you need on your laptop or phone, and a session builds the dashboard, page, doc or slides and tells you when it's done — one session per task, every session seen and answered in one place. Limited access for now: by application or invitation. Bring your own Claude subscription if you like.
llms_is: What it is: a service you open and use — sign in from a browser or a phone, nothing to install; the sessions run Anthropic's official Claude Code (or Codex), and it opens from mainland China too. The architecture is open source, and you can also self-host your own on your own Macs or Linux boxes.
llms_not: What it is not: not an Anthropic product, not a new model, not a different AI assistant — each session is the official Claude Code; subscription credentials never enter a session.
llms_for: Who it is for: people and small teams who want AI to get work done, most of whom don't write code; and admins who want to run their own and give colleagues accounts.
